rules.description: Primitive UI components. Reference only CSS variable tokens. No raw hex. No Tailwind color classes. Export named variants.
Pattern components composed from ui/ primitives only. No inline styles with raw values.
Pages contain layout and component composition only. No colors, borders, or typography styles at page level.
Master token definitions. Palette tokens first, then semantic tokens. This is the single source of truth for all visual values.
Business logic and utilities. No React, no UI concerns. Fully testable in isolation.
